/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal AI Controller
 * Handles AI provider switching (Gemini / Ollama / Heuristic), Gemini Key Vault,
 * model testing, configuration persistence, and batch session analysis polling.
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state } from '../../state.js';
import { escapeHtml, formatIST } from '../../utils.js';
import { showToast, showBatchProgress, hideBatchProgress, updateGlobalTray, hideGlobalTray } from '../../toasts.js';
import { loadProjectEvents } from '../timeline.js';
import { openUnifiedSettingsModal, closeUnifiedSettingsModal } from './modal_base.js';

let batchPollInterval = null;

export function updateAiProviderBoxes(provider) {
  if (!DOM.boxProviderOllama || !DOM.boxProviderGemini || !DOM.boxProviderHeuristic) return;
  DOM.boxProviderOllama.style.display = provider === 'ollama' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  DOM.boxProviderGemini.style.display = provider === 'gemini' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  DOM.boxProviderHeuristic.style.display = provider === 'heuristic' ? 'flex' : 'none';
}

export async function loadAiSettings() {
  if (DOM.ollamaTestStatus) {
    DOM.ollamaTestStatus.className = 'test-status-badge hidden';
    DOM.ollamaTestStatus.textContent = '';
  }
  if (DOM.geminiTestStatus) {
    DOM.geminiTestStatus.className = 'test-status-badge hidden';
    DOM.geminiTestStatus.textContent = '';
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/ai/config');
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success && data.config) {
      const c = data.config;
      if (DOM.selAiProvider) DOM.selAiProvider.value = c.preferred_provider || 'heuristic';
      if (DOM.inpOllamaUrl) DOM.inpOllamaUrl.value = c.ollama_base_url || 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
      if (DOM.inpOllamaModel) DOM.inpOllamaModel.value = c.ollama_model || 'qwen2.5-coder:7b';
      if (DOM.selGeminiModel) DOM.selGeminiModel.value = c.gemini_model || 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite';

      state.savedGeminiKeys = c.saved_gemini_keys || c.saved_keys || [];
      populateGeminiKeyVaultDropdown(state.savedGeminiKeys, c);
      if (DOM.selAiProvider) updateAiProviderBoxes(DOM.selAiProvider.value);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to load AI config:', err);
  }
}

export function openAiSettingsModal() {
  openUnifiedSettingsModal('ai');
}

export function closeAiSettingsModal() {
  closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
}

export function populateGeminiKeyVaultDropdown(keys, config) {
  if (!DOM.selGeminiKeyVault) return;
  DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.innerHTML = '';

  let activeKeyId = null;
  keys.forEach((k) => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = k.id;
    opt.textContent = `${k.label || k.suffix} ${k.active ? '★ Active' : ''}`;
    if (k.active) {
      opt.selected = true;
      activeKeyId = k.id;
    }
    DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.appendChild(opt);
  });

  const newOpt = document.createElement('option');
  newOpt.value = '__new__';
  newOpt.textContent = '+ Add / Paste New Key';
  DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.appendChild(newOpt);

  if (!activeKeyId && keys.length === 0) {
    newOpt.selected = true;
  }

  onGeminiKeyVaultSelectionChanged();
}

export function onGeminiKeyVaultSelectionChanged() {
  if (!DOM.selGeminiKeyVault) return;
  const selectedVal = DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.value;

  if (selectedVal === '__new__') {
    DOM.inpGeminiKey.value = '';
    DOM.inpGeminiKey.disabled = false;
    DOM.inpGeminiKey.placeholder = 'AIzaSy•••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••';
    if (DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey) DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey.style.display = 'none';
    if (DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo) {
      DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo.textContent = 'New Key Entry';
      DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo.style.color = '#a855f7';
    }
    if (DOM.helpGeminiKey) {
      DOM.helpGeminiKey.innerHTML = 'Pasting a new key saves it permanently to the vault and activates it upon save.';
    }
  } else {
    const selectedKey = (state.savedGeminiKeys || []).find((k) => k.id === selectedVal);
    if (selectedKey) {
      DOM.inpGeminiKey.value = selectedKey.masked_key || '••••••••••••••••';
      DOM.inpGeminiKey.disabled = true;
      if (DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey) DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey.style.display = 'inline-flex';
      if (DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo) {
        DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo.textContent = selectedKey.active ? '★ Active Key' : 'Saved in Vault';
        DOM.geminiActiveKeyInfo.style.color = selectedKey.active ? '#4ade80' : '#94a3b8';
      }
      if (DOM.helpGeminiKey) {
        DOM.helpGeminiKey.innerHTML = `Added: ${escapeHtml(formatIST(selectedKey.added_at))} &bull; Last used: ${escapeHtml(formatIST(selectedKey.last_used))}`;
      }
    }
  }
}

export async function handleDeleteGeminiKey() {
  if (!DOM.selGeminiKeyVault) return;
  const selectedVal = DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.value;
  if (selectedVal === '__new__') return;

  if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to remove this API key from the vault?')) {
    return;
  }

  DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey.disabled = true;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/ai/config', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ delete_key_id: selectedVal }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success && data.config) {
      showToast('Key removed from vault.', 'success');
      state.savedGeminiKeys = data.config.saved_gemini_keys || data.config.saved_keys || [];
      populateGeminiKeyVaultDropdown(state.savedGeminiKeys, data.config);
    } else {
      showToast(`Failed to remove key: ${data.message || data.error}`, 'error');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Delete failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey.disabled = false;
  }
}

export async function handleTestAiConnection(provider) {
  const badge = provider === 'ollama' ? DOM.ollamaTestStatus : DOM.geminiTestStatus;
  const btn = provider === 'ollama' ? DOM.btnTestOllama : DOM.btnTestGemini;
  if (!badge || !btn) return;

  btn.disabled = true;
  badge.className = 'test-status-badge testing';
  badge.textContent = 'Connecting…';

  const payload = { provider: provider };
  if (provider === 'ollama') {
    payload.base_url = DOM.inpOllamaUrl.value.trim();
    payload.model = DOM.inpOllamaModel.value.trim();
  } else if (provider === 'gemini') {
    const vaultVal = DOM.selGeminiKeyVault ? DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.value : '__new__';
    if (vaultVal !== '__new__') {
      payload.key_id = vaultVal;
    } else {
      payload.api_key = DOM.inpGeminiKey.value.trim();
    }
    payload.model = DOM.selGeminiModel.value;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/ai/test', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      badge.className = 'test-status-badge success';
      badge.textContent = `✔ ${data.message}`;
    } else {
      badge.className = 'test-status-badge error';
      badge.textContent = `✖ ${data.message || data.error}`;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    badge.className = 'test-status-badge error';
    badge.textContent = `✖ Error: ${err.message}`;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
}

export async function handleSaveAiSettings(e) {
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  const vaultVal = DOM.selGeminiKeyVault ? DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.value : '__new__';
  const payload = {
    preferred_provider: DOM.selAiProvider.value,
    ollama_base_url: DOM.inpOllamaUrl.value.trim(),
    ollama_model: DOM.inpOllamaModel.value.trim(),
    gemini_model: DOM.selGeminiModel.value,
  };

  if (vaultVal !== '__new__') {
    payload.select_key_id = vaultVal;
  } else {
    payload.gemini_api_key = DOM.inpGeminiKey.value.trim();
  }

  DOM.btnSaveAiConfig.disabled = true;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/ai/config', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      showToast('AI settings saved successfully!', 'success');
      closeAiSettingsModal();
    } else {
      showToast(`Save failed: ${data.message || data.error}`, 'error');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Save failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    DOM.btnSaveAiConfig.disabled = false;
  }
}

export function startBatchProgressPolling(projectName) {
  if (batchPollInterval) clearInterval(batchPollInterval);

  showBatchProgress(0, 1, 'running', null, false, 0);
  updateGlobalTray(projectName, 0, 1, 'running', null, false, 0);

  batchPollInterval = setInterval(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(projectName)}/analyze-batch/status`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const cooling = !!data.cooling_down;
      const cooldownS = Number(data.cooldown_remaining_s || 0);

      if (data.status === 'running') {
        showBatchProgress(data.analyzed_count || 0, data.total_events || 1, 'running', null, cooling, cooldownS);
        updateGlobalTray(projectName, data.analyzed_count || 0, data.total_events || 1, 'running', null, cooling, cooldownS);
      } else if (data.status === 'completed') {
        clearInterval(batchPollInterval);
        batchPollInterval = null;
        showBatchProgress(data.total_events || 0, data.total_events || 0, 'completed', null, false, 0);
        updateGlobalTray(projectName, data.total_events || 0, data.total_events || 0, 'completed', null, false, 0);
        if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
          DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.disabled = false;
          DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Batch Analyze Session';
        }
        showToast(`Batch AI synthesis completed successfully for ${projectName}!`, 'success', 'Batch Analysis');
        await loadProjectEvents(projectName);
      } else if (data.status === 'failed') {
        clearInterval(batchPollInterval);
        batchPollInterval = null;
        showBatchProgress(data.analyzed_count || 0, data.total_events || 0, 'failed', data.error, false, 0);
        updateGlobalTray(projectName, data.analyzed_count || 0, data.total_events || 0, 'failed', data.error, false, 0);
        if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
          DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.disabled = false;
          DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Batch Analyze Session';
        }
        showToast(`Batch AI synthesis halted: ${data.error || 'Failed'}`, 'error', 'Batch Analysis Failed');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Batch status polling error:', err);
    }
  }, 1200);
}

export async function handleBatchAnalyzeSession(forceAll = false) {
  if (!state.selectedProject) {
    showToast('Please select a project first.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
    DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.disabled = true;
    DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Analyzing…';
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedProject)}/analyze-batch`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ force_all: forceAll }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Batch analysis request failed');
    }

    if (data.total_events === 0) {
      showToast('All prompt bursts already analyzed!', 'success');
      hideBatchProgress();
      if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
        DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.disabled = false;
        DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Batch Analyze Session';
      }
      return;
    }

    showToast(`Batch analysis started for ${data.total_events} bursts in background.`, 'info');
    startBatchProgressPolling(state.selectedProject);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Batch analyze error:', err);
    showToast(`Batch analyze failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
    if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
      DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.disabled = false;
      DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Batch Analyze Session';
    }
  }
}

export function handleBatchRetry() {
  handleBatchAnalyzeSession(false);
}

export function initModalAiListeners() {
  if (DOM.btnHeaderAiSettings) DOM.btnHeaderAiSettings.addEventListener('click', openAiSettingsModal);
  if (DOM.modalAiSettingsClose) DOM.modalAiSettingsClose.addEventListener('click', closeAiSettingsModal);
  if (DOM.modalAiSettingsCancel) DOM.modalAiSettingsCancel.addEventListener('click', closeAiSettingsModal);
  if (DOM.formAiSettings) DOM.formAiSettings.addEventListener('submit', handleSaveAiSettings);
  if (DOM.selAiProvider) {
    DOM.selAiProvider.addEventListener('change', (e) => updateAiProviderBoxes(e.target.value));
  }
  if (DOM.btnTestOllama) {
    DOM.btnTestOllama.addEventListener('click', () => handleTestAiConnection('ollama'));
  }
  if (DOM.btnTestGemini) {
    DOM.btnTestGemini.addEventListener('click', () => handleTestAiConnection('gemini'));
  }
  if (DOM.selGeminiKeyVault) {
    DOM.selGeminiKeyVault.addEventListener('change', onGeminiKeyVaultSelectionChanged);
  }
  if (DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey) {
    DOM.btnDeleteGeminiKey.addEventListener('click', handleDeleteGeminiKey);
  }

  // Batch Analyze Session
  if (DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession) {
    DOM.btnBatchAnalyzeSession.addEventListener('click', () => handleBatchAnalyzeSession(false));
  }
  if (DOM.btnBatchRetry) {
    DOM.btnBatchRetry.addEventListener('click', handleBatchRetry);
  }
  if (DOM.trayCloseBtn) {
    DOM.trayCloseBtn.onclick = hideGlobalTray;
  }

  if (DOM.modalAiSettings) {
    DOM.modalAiSettings.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === DOM.modalAiSettings) closeAiSettingsModal();
    });
  }
}

/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal Base Controller
 * Handles modal show/hide utilities, escape key listener, new session modal,
 * and unified settings modal tab navigation (AI / Git / Trash / Engine).
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state } from '../../state.js';
import { slugify } from '../../utils.js';
import { showToast } from '../../toasts.js';
import { apiPost } from '../../api.js';
import { refreshProjects, selectProject } from '../dashboard.js';
import { isEcoModeActive, setEcoMode } from '../../eco_mode.js';
import { loadAiSettings } from './modal_ai.js';
import { loadGitSettings } from './modal_git.js';
import { loadTrashBinItems, populateDeleteProjectInfo } from './modal_trash.js';
import { loadEngineHealth, loadWorkerLogRaw } from './modal_health.js';
import { loadWorkspaceGitignore } from './modal_workspace.js';

export function getSettingsTabButtons() {
  return typeof DOM.settingsTabButtons === 'function'
    ? DOM.settingsTabButtons()
    : (DOM.settingsTabButtons || document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-btn'));
}

export function getSettingsTabPanes() {
  return typeof DOM.settingsTabPanes === 'function'
    ? DOM.settingsTabPanes()
    : (DOM.settingsTabPanes || document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-pane'));
}

export function openModal(modalEl) {
  if (modalEl) modalEl.classList.add('open');
}

export function closeModal(modalEl) {
  if (modalEl) modalEl.classList.remove('open');
}

// =============================================================================
// New Session Modal
// =============================================================================

export function openNewSessionModal() {
  if (DOM.formNewSession) DOM.formNewSession.reset();
  if (DOM.slugPreview) DOM.slugPreview.textContent = 'my_project';
  if (DOM.debounceValDisplay) DOM.debounceValDisplay.innerHTML = '3.5s <span class="badge badge-recommended">Recommended</span>';
  if (DOM.rngDebounce) DOM.rngDebounce.value = '3.5';
  if (DOM.selIdeProfile) DOM.selIdeProfile.value = 'antigravity';
  if (DOM.groupCustomIdeMarker) DOM.groupCustomIdeMarker.classList.add('hidden');
  if (DOM.inpCustomIdeMarker) DOM.inpCustomIdeMarker.value = '';
  if (DOM.modalError) DOM.modalError.classList.add('hidden');
  if (DOM.modalSpinner) DOM.modalSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
  if (DOM.modalSubmitBtn) DOM.modalSubmitBtn.disabled = false;
  if (DOM.modalNewSession) DOM.modalNewSession.classList.add('open');
}

export function closeNewSessionModal() {
  if (DOM.modalNewSession) DOM.modalNewSession.classList.remove('open');
}

export async function handleLaunchNewSession(e) {
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  const name = DOM.inpProjectName ? DOM.inpProjectName.value.trim() : '';
  const targetPath = DOM.inpTargetPath ? DOM.inpTargetPath.value.trim() : '';
  const scaffold = DOM.chkScaffold ? DOM.chkScaffold.checked : false;
  const debounce = DOM.rngDebounce ? parseFloat(DOM.rngDebounce.value) : 3.5;

  if (!name || !targetPath) {
    if (DOM.modalError) {
      DOM.modalError.textContent = 'Please fill in both project name and workspace path.';
      DOM.modalError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    return;
  }

  if (DOM.modalError) DOM.modalError.classList.add('hidden');
  if (DOM.modalSpinner) DOM.modalSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');
  if (DOM.modalSubmitBtn) DOM.modalSubmitBtn.disabled = true;

  try {
    const trackReads = DOM.chkPowerReads ? DOM.chkPowerReads.checked : true;
    const trackExec = DOM.chkPowerExec ? DOM.chkPowerExec.checked : true;
    const shadowGit = DOM.chkPowerShadowGit ? DOM.chkPowerShadowGit.checked : true;
    const gitInitPrimary = DOM.chkPowerGitInit ? DOM.chkPowerGitInit.checked : false;
    const ideProfile = DOM.selIdeProfile ? DOM.selIdeProfile.value : 'antigravity';
    const ideCustomMarker = (DOM.selIdeProfile && DOM.selIdeProfile.value === 'custom' && DOM.inpCustomIdeMarker)
      ? DOM.inpCustomIdeMarker.value.trim()
      : null;

    const res = await apiPost('/api/projects/start', {
      project: name,
      path: targetPath,
      scaffold: scaffold,
      debounce: debounce,
      track_reads: trackReads,
      track_exec: trackExec,
      shadow_git: shadowGit,
      git_init_primary: gitInitPrimary,
      ide_profile: ideProfile,
      ide_custom_marker: ideCustomMarker,
    });

    closeNewSessionModal();
    showToast(`Worker started for '${name}' (PID ${res.result ? res.result.pid : ''})`, 'success');
    await refreshProjects();
    selectProject(name, 'current');
  } catch (err) {
    if (DOM.modalError) {
      DOM.modalError.textContent = `Launch failed: ${err.message}`;
      DOM.modalError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  } finally {
    if (DOM.modalSpinner) DOM.modalSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
    if (DOM.modalSubmitBtn) DOM.modalSubmitBtn.disabled = false;
  }
}

// =============================================================================
// Engine Settings
// =============================================================================

export function loadEngineSettings() {
  let savedDebounce = '600';
  try {
    savedDebounce = localStorage.getItem('spd_default_debounce') || '600';
  } catch (_) {}
  if (DOM.selDefaultDebounce) {
    DOM.selDefaultDebounce.value = savedDebounce;
  }
  if (DOM.chkEcoModeSetting) {
    DOM.chkEcoModeSetting.checked = isEcoModeActive();
  }
}

export function handleSaveEngineSettings() {
  if (DOM.selDefaultDebounce) {
    const val = DOM.selDefaultDebounce.value;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('spd_default_debounce', val);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  if (DOM.chkEcoModeSetting) {
    setEcoMode(DOM.chkEcoModeSetting.checked);
  }
  showToast('Engine settings saved.', 'success');
  closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
}

// =============================================================================
// Unified Settings Modal
// =============================================================================

export function switchSettingsTab(tabName) {
  const tabs = ['ai', 'git', 'trash', 'engine', 'health', 'workspace'];
  const activeTab = tabs.includes(tabName) ? tabName : 'ai';

  const tabButtons = getSettingsTabButtons();
  if (tabButtons) {
    tabButtons.forEach((btn) => {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tab === activeTab);
    });
  }

  const tabPanes = getSettingsTabPanes();
  if (tabPanes) {
    tabPanes.forEach((pane) => {
      pane.classList.toggle('hidden', pane.id !== `pane-settings-${activeTab}`);
    });
  }

  if (activeTab === 'ai') {
    loadAiSettings();
  } else if (activeTab === 'git') {
    loadGitSettings();
  } else if (activeTab === 'trash') {
    loadTrashBinItems();
    if (state.selectedProject) {
      populateDeleteProjectInfo();
    }
  } else if (activeTab === 'engine') {
    loadEngineSettings();
  } else if (activeTab === 'health') {
    loadEngineHealth();
    loadWorkerLogRaw();
  } else if (activeTab === 'workspace') {
    loadWorkspaceGitignore();
  }
}

export function openUnifiedSettingsModal(initialTab = 'ai') {
  if (DOM.modalUnifiedSettings) {
    DOM.modalUnifiedSettings.classList.add('open');
  }
  switchSettingsTab(initialTab);
}

export function closeUnifiedSettingsModal() {
  if (DOM.modalUnifiedSettings) {
    DOM.modalUnifiedSettings.classList.remove('open');
  }
}

export function initModalBaseListeners() {
  // Unified Settings Modal
  if (DOM.btnHeaderSettings) {
    DOM.btnHeaderSettings.addEventListener('click', () => openUnifiedSettingsModal('ai'));
  }
  if (DOM.modalUnifiedSettingsClose) {
    DOM.modalUnifiedSettingsClose.addEventListener('click', closeUnifiedSettingsModal);
  }
  if (DOM.modalUnifiedSettingsCancel) {
    DOM.modalUnifiedSettingsCancel.addEventListener('click', closeUnifiedSettingsModal);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.modal-cancel-unified').forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', closeUnifiedSettingsModal);
  });

  const tabButtons = getSettingsTabButtons();
  if (tabButtons) {
    tabButtons.forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => switchSettingsTab(btn.dataset.tab));
    });
  }

  if (DOM.btnSaveEngineSettings) {
    DOM.btnSaveEngineSettings.addEventListener('click', handleSaveEngineSettings);
  }
  if (DOM.modalUnifiedSettings) {
    DOM.modalUnifiedSettings.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === DOM.modalUnifiedSettings) closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
    });
  }

  // New Session
  if (DOM.btnNewSession) DOM.btnNewSession.addEventListener('click', openNewSessionModal);
  if (DOM.modalCloseBtn) DOM.modalCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeNewSessionModal);
  if (DOM.modalCancelBtn) DOM.modalCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeNewSessionModal);
  if (DOM.formNewSession) DOM.formNewSession.addEventListener('submit', handleLaunchNewSession);
  if (DOM.inpProjectName) {
    DOM.inpProjectName.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      if (DOM.slugPreview) DOM.slugPreview.textContent = slugify(e.target.value);
    });
  }
  if (DOM.selIdeProfile) {
    DOM.selIdeProfile.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      if (DOM.groupCustomIdeMarker) {
        DOM.groupCustomIdeMarker.classList.toggle('hidden', e.target.value !== 'custom');
      }
    });
  }
  if (DOM.modalNewSession) {
    DOM.modalNewSession.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === DOM.modalNewSession) closeNewSessionModal();
    });
  }

  // Escape key global listener to close open modals
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' || e.keyCode === 27) {
      const openModals = document.querySelectorAll('.modal.open, .modal-backdrop.open');
      openModals.forEach((m) => m.classList.remove('open'));
    }
  });
}

/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal Git Controller
 * Handles GitHub credentials, remote repository settings, connection testing,
 * unpushed milestone scoping, AI regeneration, and milestone history.
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state } from '../../state.js';
import { showToast } from '../../toasts.js';
import { escapeHtml, setButtonLoading } from '../../utils.js';
import { refreshProjects, loadProjectSpecs, refreshDashboard } from '../dashboard.js';
import { openUnifiedSettingsModal, closeUnifiedSettingsModal } from './modal_base.js';

export async function loadGitSettings() {
  if (DOM.gitTestStatus) {
    DOM.gitTestStatus.className = 'git-test-badge hidden';
    DOM.gitTestStatus.textContent = '';
  }
  const proj = state.selectedProject;
  loadMilestoneHistory(proj);
  try {
    const url = proj ? `/api/git/config?project=${encodeURIComponent(proj)}` : '/api/git/config';
    const res = await fetch(url);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success && data.config) {
      const c = data.config;
      if (DOM.inpGitUsername) DOM.inpGitUsername.value = c.github_username || '';
      if (DOM.inpGitToken) DOM.inpGitToken.value = c.github_token || '';
      if (DOM.inpGitDefaultRemote) DOM.inpGitDefaultRemote.value = c.default_remote || 'origin';
      if (DOM.inpGitDefaultBranch) DOM.inpGitDefaultBranch.value = c.default_branch || 'main';
      if (DOM.chkGitAutoChangelog) DOM.chkGitAutoChangelog.checked = c.auto_generate_changelog !== false;
      if (DOM.chkGitAutopush) DOM.chkGitAutopush.checked = Boolean(c.auto_push);
      if (DOM.inpGitTestUrl && !DOM.inpGitTestUrl.value) {
        DOM.inpGitTestUrl.value = c.default_remote && c.default_remote.startsWith('http') ? c.default_remote : '';
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to load git config:', err);
  }
}

export function openGitSettingsModal() {
  openUnifiedSettingsModal('git');
}

export function closeGitSettingsModal() {
  closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
}

export async function handleSaveGitSettings(e) {
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  const payload = {
    project: state.selectedProject,
    github_username: DOM.inpGitUsername?.value.trim() || '',
    github_token: DOM.inpGitToken?.value.trim() || '',
    default_remote: DOM.inpGitDefaultRemote?.value.trim() || 'origin',
    default_branch: DOM.inpGitDefaultBranch?.value.trim() || 'main',
    auto_generate_changelog: DOM.chkGitAutoChangelog?.checked ?? true,
    auto_push: DOM.chkGitAutopush ? DOM.chkGitAutopush.checked : false,
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/git/config', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to save settings');
    }
    if (state.selectedProject) {
      loadProjectSpecs(state.selectedProject);
    }
    showToast('GitHub settings saved successfully.', 'success');
    closeGitSettingsModal();
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Save failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

export async function handleTestGitConnection() {
  const testUrl = DOM.inpGitTestUrl?.value.trim() || DOM.inpGitDefaultRemote?.value.trim() || '';
  const user = DOM.inpGitUsername?.value.trim() || '';
  const token = DOM.inpGitToken?.value.trim() || '';

  if (DOM.gitTestStatus) {
    DOM.gitTestStatus.className = 'git-test-badge testing';
    DOM.gitTestStatus.textContent = 'Testing connection via git ls-remote…';
  }
  if (DOM.btnTestGitConnection) DOM.btnTestGitConnection.disabled = true;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/git/test', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ repo_url: testUrl, github_username: user, github_token: token }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (DOM.gitTestStatus) {
      if (data.success) {
        DOM.gitTestStatus.className = 'git-test-badge success';
        DOM.gitTestStatus.textContent = `✔ ${data.message || 'Connection successful!'}`;
      } else {
        DOM.gitTestStatus.className = 'git-test-badge error';
        DOM.gitTestStatus.textContent = `✖ ${data.message || 'Connection failed.'}`;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (DOM.gitTestStatus) {
      DOM.gitTestStatus.className = 'git-test-badge error';
      DOM.gitTestStatus.textContent = `✖ Error: ${err.message}`;
    }
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnTestGitConnection) DOM.btnTestGitConnection.disabled = false;
  }
}

export async function loadMilestoneHistory(slug) {
  const container = DOM.gitMilestoneHistoryList;
  if (!container) return;

  const projectSlug = slug || state.selectedProject;
  if (!projectSlug) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="mono" style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-align: center; padding: 12px 0;">Select a project to view milestones.</div>';
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(projectSlug)}/milestones`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to load milestones');
    }

    const milestones = data.milestones || [];
    if (DOM.gitMilestonesCount) {
      DOM.gitMilestonesCount.textContent = `Last ${Math.min(5, milestones.length)} push${milestones.length === 1 ? '' : 'es'}`;
    }

    if (milestones.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="mono" style="font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-align: center; padding: 12px 0;">No milestones pushed yet.</div>';
      return;
    }

    const recent = milestones.slice(0, 5);
    container.innerHTML = recent.map((m) => {
      const shortSha = m.commit_sha ? m.commit_sha.substring(0, 7) : '-------';
      let bursts = [];
      try {
        bursts = typeof m.burst_ids === 'string' ? JSON.parse(m.burst_ids) : (m.burst_ids || []);
      } catch {
        bursts = [];
      }
      const burstInfo = bursts.length ? `${bursts.length} burst${bursts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'Baseline';
      const timeStr = m.pushed_at || 'Recent';

      return `
        <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border-card); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 8px 10px;">
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <strong style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: #f1f5f9; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 70%;" title="${escapeHtml(m.commit_title || '')}">
              ${escapeHtml(m.commit_title || 'Milestone Commit')}
            </strong>
            <span class="badge mono" style="font-size: 0.7rem; background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15); color: #38bdf8;">${escapeHtml(shortSha)}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim);">
            <span>📦 ${escapeHtml(burstInfo)}</span>
            <span>🕒 ${escapeHtml(timeStr)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to load milestone history:', err);
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--color-danger); padding: 8px;">Failed to load milestones: ${err.message}</div>`;
  }
}

export async function openPushGitModal(projectSlug) {
  const slug = projectSlug || state.selectedProject;
  if (!slug) {
    showToast('Please select a project first.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  // Reset form fields and hide error banners
  if (DOM.gitPushErrorBanner) {
    DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.classList.add('hidden');
    DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.textContent = '';
  }
  if (DOM.syncError) {
    DOM.syncError.classList.add('hidden');
    DOM.syncError.textContent = '';
  }
  if (DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner) {
    DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  // Set loading state on title and body
  if (DOM.txtCommitTitle) DOM.txtCommitTitle.value = 'Analyzing unpushed bursts...';
  if (DOM.txtCommitBody) DOM.txtCommitBody.value = 'Analyzing unpushed bursts...';
  if (DOM.txtChangelogEntry) DOM.txtChangelogEntry.value = '';
  if (DOM.badgeGitBurstCount) DOM.badgeGitBurstCount.textContent = 'Analyzing...';
  if (DOM.badgeGitAiProvider) DOM.badgeGitAiProvider.textContent = 'AI SYNTHESIZER';

  if (DOM.btnHeaderPushGit) DOM.btnHeaderPushGit.disabled = true;
  if (DOM.btnConfirmPushGit) DOM.btnConfirmPushGit.disabled = true;
  if (DOM.modalPushGit) DOM.modalPushGit.classList.add('open');

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/unpushed-milestone`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to synthesize unpushed milestone');
    }

    if (data.has_unpushed === false) {
      if (DOM.gitPushFormContainer) DOM.gitPushFormContainer.classList.add('hidden');
      if (DOM.btnConfirmPushGit) {
        DOM.btnConfirmPushGit.classList.add('hidden');
        DOM.btnConfirmPushGit.disabled = true;
      }
      if (DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner) DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
      if (DOM.badgeGitBurstCount) DOM.badgeGitBurstCount.textContent = '0 unpushed bursts';
      if (DOM.syncEventsCount) DOM.syncEventsCount.textContent = '0';
    } else {
      if (DOM.gitPushFormContainer) DOM.gitPushFormContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
      if (DOM.btnConfirmPushGit) {
        DOM.btnConfirmPushGit.classList.remove('hidden');
        DOM.btnConfirmPushGit.disabled = false;
      }
      if (DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner) DOM.gitNoUnpushedBanner.classList.add('hidden');
      const count = data.bursts_count || 1;
      const countText = `${count} unpushed burst${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      if (DOM.badgeGitBurstCount) DOM.badgeGitBurstCount.textContent = countText;
      if (DOM.syncEventsCount) DOM.syncEventsCount.textContent = String(count);

      if (DOM.badgeGitAiProvider) {
        DOM.badgeGitAiProvider.textContent = (data.provider || data.mode_used || 'AI').toUpperCase();
      }

      if (DOM.txtCommitTitle) DOM.txtCommitTitle.value = data.title || 'feat: milestone sync';
      if (DOM.txtCommitBody) DOM.txtCommitBody.value = data.body || '';
      if (DOM.txtChangelogEntry) DOM.txtChangelogEntry.value = data.changelog || '';

      const spec = state.projectSpecs[slug] || {};
      if (DOM.inpSyncRemote && !DOM.inpSyncRemote.value) {
        DOM.inpSyncRemote.value = spec.remote_url || 'origin';
      }
      if (DOM.inpSyncBranch && !DOM.inpSyncBranch.value) {
        DOM.inpSyncBranch.value = spec.remote_branch || 'main';
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Unpushed milestone error:', err);
    if (DOM.gitPushErrorBanner) {
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.textContent = `Error: ${err.message}`;
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    showToast(`Failed to load milestone: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnHeaderPushGit) DOM.btnHeaderPushGit.disabled = false;
  }
}

export const handleOpenSyncReview = openPushGitModal;

export async function handleRegenerateMilestoneAi() {
  const slug = state.selectedProject;
  if (!slug) return;

  const btn = DOM.btnGitRegenerateAi;
  if (btn) setButtonLoading(btn, true, 'Generating...');

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/synthesize-milestone?force_ai=true`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ force_ai: true }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to regenerate with AI');
    }

    if (DOM.txtCommitTitle && data.title) DOM.txtCommitTitle.value = data.title;
    if (DOM.txtCommitBody && data.body) DOM.txtCommitBody.value = data.body;
    if (DOM.txtChangelogEntry && data.changelog) DOM.txtChangelogEntry.value = data.changelog;
    if (DOM.badgeGitAiProvider) {
      DOM.badgeGitAiProvider.textContent = (data.provider || data.mode_used || 'AI').toUpperCase();
    }
    showToast('Commit details regenerated with AI.', 'success');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Regenerate AI error:', err);
    showToast(`AI regeneration failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (btn) setButtonLoading(btn, false);
  }
}

export function closeSyncReviewModal() {
  if (DOM.modalPushGit) DOM.modalPushGit.classList.remove('open');
  if (DOM.modalSyncReview) DOM.modalSyncReview.classList.remove('open');
}

export async function handleConfirmSyncPush() {
  if (!state.selectedProject) return;

  const commitTitle = DOM.txtCommitTitle?.value.trim() || '';
  if (!commitTitle) {
    if (DOM.gitPushErrorBanner) {
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.textContent = 'Commit title is required.';
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    return;
  }

  const commitBody = DOM.txtCommitBody?.value.trim() || '';
  const fullCommitMsg = commitBody ? `${commitTitle}\n\n${commitBody}` : commitTitle;
  const changelogContent = DOM.txtChangelogEntry?.value.trim() || '';
  let remote = DOM.inpSyncRemote?.value.trim() || 'origin';
  const branch = DOM.inpSyncBranch?.value.trim() || 'main';
  const autoCreate = DOM.chkSyncAutoCreateRepo ? DOM.chkSyncAutoCreateRepo.checked : false;

  if (DOM.gitPushErrorBanner) DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.classList.add('hidden');
  if (DOM.btnConfirmPushGit) setButtonLoading(DOM.btnConfirmPushGit, true, 'Pushing...');
  if (DOM.syncSpinner) DOM.syncSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');

  function updateStepper(step, pct, msg) {
    if (DOM.syncStepperContainer) DOM.syncStepperContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (DOM.syncStepperFill) DOM.syncStepperFill.style.width = `${pct}%`;
    if (DOM.syncStepperMsg) DOM.syncStepperMsg.textContent = msg;
    [DOM.step1, DOM.step2, DOM.step3].forEach((el, idx) => {
      if (!el) return;
      const num = idx + 1;
      el.classList.remove('active', 'done');
      if (num < step) el.classList.add('done');
      else if (num === step) el.classList.add('active');
    });
  }

  try {
    updateStepper(1, 33, '1/3 Generating semantic changelog & commit structure…');
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));

    if (autoCreate) {
      updateStepper(2, 66, '2/3 Verifying remote repository on GitHub…');
      let repoName = state.selectedProject;
      if (remote.startsWith('http://') || remote.startsWith('https://')) {
        const parts = remote.replace(/\.git$/, '').split('/');
        repoName = parts[parts.length - 1] || state.selectedProject;
      }

      const createRes = await fetch('/api/git/create-repo', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          project_name: state.selectedProject,
          repo_name: repoName,
          private: false,
        }),
      });
      const createData = await createRes.json();
      if (!createRes.ok || !createData.success) {
        throw new Error(createData.message || createData.error || 'Failed to auto-create GitHub repository');
      }
      if (createData.clone_url) {
        remote = createData.clone_url;
        if (DOM.inpSyncRemote) DOM.inpSyncRemote.value = createData.clone_url;
      }
      if (createData.created) {
        showToast(`Repository '${repoName}' created on GitHub!`, 'info');
      }
    } else {
      updateStepper(2, 66, '2/3 Remote repository verified…');
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
    }

    updateStepper(3, 90, '3/3 Staging, committing & pushing to GitHub…');

    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedProject)}/git-push`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        remote_url: remote,
        remote: remote,
        branch: branch,
        commit_message: fullCommitMsg,
        changelog_content: changelogContent,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Git push failed');
    }

    updateStepper(3, 100, '✔ Pushed to GitHub successfully!');
    showToast('🚀 Milestone pushed and recorded in session database', 'success');
    setTimeout(async () => {
      closeSyncReviewModal();
      await refreshDashboard();
    }, 600);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Git push error:', err);
    if (DOM.gitPushErrorBanner) {
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.textContent = `Git push failed: ${err.message}`;
      DOM.gitPushErrorBanner.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    showToast(`Git push failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnConfirmPushGit) setButtonLoading(DOM.btnConfirmPushGit, false);
    if (DOM.syncSpinner) DOM.syncSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
  }
}

export function initModalGitListeners() {
  DOM.btnHeaderGitSettings?.addEventListener('click', openGitSettingsModal);
  DOM.modalGitSettingsClose?.addEventListener('click', closeGitSettingsModal);
  DOM.modalGitSettingsCancel?.addEventListener('click', closeGitSettingsModal);
  DOM.formGitSettings?.addEventListener('submit', handleSaveGitSettings);
  DOM.btnTestGitConnection?.addEventListener('click', handleTestGitConnection);

  DOM.btnHeaderPushGit?.addEventListener('click', () => openPushGitModal());
  DOM.btnSpecsPushGh?.addEventListener('click', () => openPushGitModal());
  DOM.btnGitRegenerateAi?.addEventListener('click', handleRegenerateMilestoneAi);
  DOM.modalSyncReviewClose?.addEventListener('click', closeSyncReviewModal);
  DOM.modalSyncCancel?.addEventListener('click', closeSyncReviewModal);
  DOM.btnConfirmPushGit?.addEventListener('click', handleConfirmSyncPush);

  DOM.modalGitSettings?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === DOM.modalGitSettings) closeGitSettingsModal();
  });
  DOM.modalPushGit?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target === DOM.modalPushGit) closeSyncReviewModal();
  });
}

/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal Health & Diagnostics Controller
 * Handles system diagnostics health grid, active path manifest copying,
 * and emergency raw worker log streaming.
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state } from '../../state.js';
import { escapeHtml, setButtonLoading } from '../../utils.js';
import { showToast } from '../../toasts.js';
import { refreshDashboard } from '../dashboard.js';

let logTailInterval = null;

export async function copyPathToClipboard(text, btnEl) {
  if (!text) return;
  try {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    } else {
      const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
      textarea.value = text;
      textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
      textarea.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(textarea);
      textarea.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textarea);
    }
    if (btnEl) {
      const origHtml = btnEl.innerHTML;
      btnEl.innerHTML = '✔ Copied';
      btnEl.disabled = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        btnEl.innerHTML = origHtml;
        btnEl.disabled = false;
      }, 1500);
    }
    showToast('Path copied to clipboard.', 'success');
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Failed to copy path: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

export async function loadEngineHealth() {
  if (DOM.btnRefreshHealth) {
    DOM.btnRefreshHealth.disabled = true;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/engine/health');
    const data = await res.json();

    // 1. Overall Badge
    if (DOM.healthOverallBadge) {
      const status = (data.overall_status || 'healthy').toLowerCase();
      DOM.healthOverallBadge.textContent = status.toUpperCase();
      DOM.healthOverallBadge.className = 'badge';
      if (status === 'healthy') {
        DOM.healthOverallBadge.classList.add('badge-success');
      } else if (status === 'degraded') {
        DOM.healthOverallBadge.classList.add('badge-warning');
      } else {
        DOM.healthOverallBadge.classList.add('badge-danger');
      }
    }

    // 2. Render Pipeline Grid
    renderHealthGrid(data.pipelines || {});

    // 3. Render Active Paths
    renderActivePaths(data.active_paths || {});
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to load engine health:', err);
    if (DOM.healthOverallBadge) {
      DOM.healthOverallBadge.textContent = 'DISCONNECTED';
      DOM.healthOverallBadge.className = 'badge badge-danger';
    }
    showToast(`Health check error: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnRefreshHealth) {
      DOM.btnRefreshHealth.disabled = false;
    }
  }
}

function renderHealthGrid(pipelines) {
  if (!DOM.healthPipelineGrid) return;

  const db = pipelines.database || {};
  const storage = pipelines.storage_tiers || {};
  const git = pipelines.shadow_git || {};
  const worker = pipelines.worker_daemon || {};
  const config = pipelines.configurations || {};

  const cards = [
    {
      title: 'SQLite WAL & Integrity',
      status: db.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : (db.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'degraded'),
      tag: db.wal_mode ? 'WAL ACTIVE' : 'NO WAL',
      desc: `Integrity: ${escapeHtml(db.integrity || 'ok')} • Databases: ${db.active_databases?.length || 0} • Stale locks: ${db.stale_locks?.length || 0}`,
    },
    {
      title: 'Filesystem Storage Tiers',
      status: storage.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : 'error',
      tag: storage.status === 'healthy' ? 'ALL TIERS R/W' : 'TIER ERROR',
      desc: 'current/, last_run/, history/, trash/ verified readable & writable',
    },
    {
      title: 'Shadow Git Mirror',
      status: git.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
      tag: (git.dangling_locks?.length || 0) === 0 ? 'LOCKS CLEAN' : 'LOCK DETECTED',
      desc: `Repositories: ${git.repositories?.length || 0} active • Dangling locks: ${git.dangling_locks?.length || 0}`,
    },
    {
      title: 'Worker Process Daemon',
      status: worker.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : (worker.status === 'idle' ? 'idle' : 'degraded'),
      tag: worker.status === 'idle' ? 'IDLE' : (worker.status === 'healthy' ? 'LIVE HEARTBEAT' : 'STALE HEARTBEAT'),
      desc: `Active workers: ${worker.workers?.length || 0} • Heartbeat timeout: 15s`,
    },
    {
      title: 'AI & Git Configurations',
      status: config.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
      tag: config.status === 'healthy' ? 'VALID JSON' : 'SCHEMA WARN',
      desc: 'models_config.json, git_config.json syntax & schema validated',
    },
  ];

  DOM.healthPipelineGrid.innerHTML = cards.map((c) => `
    <div class="health-card ${c.status}">
      <div class="health-card-header">
        <span class="health-card-title">${escapeHtml(c.title)}</span>
        <span class="health-status-tag ${c.status}">${escapeHtml(c.tag)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="health-card-desc">${c.desc}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderActivePaths(paths) {
  if (!DOM.healthActivePaths) return;

  const entries = [
    { label: 'Session DB', path: paths.session_db || '—' },
    { label: 'Shadow Git', path: paths.shadow_git || '—' },
    { label: 'Worker Log', path: paths.worker_log || '—' },

  DOM.healthActivePaths.innerHTML = entries.map((item) => `
    <div class="active-path-row">
      <span class="active-path-label">${escapeHtml(item.label)}</span>
      <span class="active-path-value" title="${escapeHtml(item.path)}">${escapeHtml(item.path)}</span>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs btn-copy-active-path" data-path="${escapeHtml(item.path)}">
        Copy Path
      </button>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  DOM.healthActivePaths.querySelectorAll('.btn-copy-active-path').forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => copyPathToClipboard(btn.dataset.path, btn));
  });
}

export async function loadWorkerLogRaw(projectName = null, lines = 100) {
  const targetProj = projectName || state.selectedProject || state.activeProject || '';

  if (DOM.rawLogTargetFilename) {
    DOM.rawLogTargetFilename.textContent = targetProj ? `${targetProj}/worker.log` : 'worker.log';
  }

  if (DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs) {
    DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs.disabled = true;
  }

  try {
    const slug = targetProj ? encodeURIComponent(targetProj) : '_';
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${slug}/worker-log-raw?lines=${lines}`);
    const data = await res.json();

    if (DOM.emergencyLogTerminal) {
      if (data.content && data.content.trim()) {
        DOM.emergencyLogTerminal.textContent = data.content;
      } else {
        DOM.emergencyLogTerminal.textContent = `[RAW LOG] No active log entries recorded for '${targetProj || 'engine'}'.`;
      }
      DOM.emergencyLogTerminal.scrollTop = DOM.emergencyLogTerminal.scrollHeight;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (DOM.emergencyLogTerminal) {
      DOM.emergencyLogTerminal.textContent = `[ERROR] Failed to fetch raw worker logs: ${err.message}`;
    }
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs) {
      DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs.disabled = false;
    }
  }
}

export function startLogAutoTail() {
  stopLogAutoTail();
  logTailInterval = setInterval(() => {
    const activeTab = document.querySelector('.settings-tab-btn.active');
    if (activeTab && activeTab.dataset.tab === 'health') {
      loadWorkerLogRaw(null, 100);
    } else {
      stopLogAutoTail();
      if (DOM.chkAutoTailRawLogs) DOM.chkAutoTailRawLogs.checked = false;
    }
  }, 3000);
}

export function stopLogAutoTail() {
  if (logTailInterval) {
    clearInterval(logTailInterval);
    logTailInterval = null;
  }
}

export function initModalHealthListeners() {
  if (DOM.btnRefreshHealth) {
    DOM.btnRefreshHealth.addEventListener('click', () => loadEngineHealth());
  }

  if (DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs) {
    DOM.btnRefreshRawLogs.addEventListener('click', () => loadWorkerLogRaw());
  }

  if (DOM.chkAutoTailRawLogs) {
    DOM.chkAutoTailRawLogs.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      if (e.target.checked) {
        startLogAutoTail();
      } else {
        stopLogAutoTail();
      }
    });
  }

  const purgeBtn = DOM.btnEmergencyPurge || document.getElementById('btn-emergency-purge');
  if (purgeBtn) {
    purgeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => handleEmergencyPurgeZombies());
  }
}

export async function handleEmergencyPurgeZombies() {
  const btn = DOM.btnEmergencyPurge || document.getElementById('btn-emergency-purge');
  if (!btn) return;

  setButtonLoading(btn, true, 'Purging...');

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/system/recovery/purge-zombies', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      showToast(`Terminated ${data.killed_count || 0} zombie processes.`, 'success');
      await refreshDashboard();
      await loadEngineHealth();
    } else {
      showToast(`Purge failed: ${data.error || 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Purge failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    setButtonLoading(btn, false);
  }
}

/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal Trash Controller
 * Handles Trash Bin management, soft-delete scopes, item restore, permanent purge, and project deletion.
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state } from '../../state.js';
import { escapeHtml, formatIST, formatISTTime, setButtonLoading } from '../../utils.js';
import { showToast } from '../../toasts.js';
import { refreshProjects } from '../dashboard.js';
import { loadProjectEvents } from '../timeline.js';
import { openUnifiedSettingsModal, closeUnifiedSettingsModal } from './modal_base.js';

export async function updateTrashCount() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/trash');
    const data = await res.json();
    const count = (data && typeof data.count === 'number') ? data.count : 0;
    if (DOM.headerTrashCount) DOM.headerTrashCount.textContent = count;
    if (DOM.badgeTrashCount) DOM.badgeTrashCount.textContent = count;
    document.querySelectorAll('.badge-trash-count').forEach((el) => {
      el.textContent = count;
    });
  } catch (_) {}
}

export function openTrashBinModal() {
  openUnifiedSettingsModal('trash');
}

export function closeTrashBinModal() {
  closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
}

export async function loadTrashBinItems() {
  if (!DOM.trashBinItemsContainer) return;
  DOM.trashBinItemsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Loading trash bin…</div>';

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/trash');
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to list trash');

    const items = data.items || [];
    if (DOM.headerTrashCount) DOM.headerTrashCount.textContent = items.length;

    if (items.length === 0) {
      DOM.trashBinItemsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Trash Bin is empty. No soft-deleted items.</div>';
      return;
    }

    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    items.forEach((item) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'trash-item-card';

      const scopeLabel = (item.scope || 'Item').replace(/_/g, ' ');
      const timeStr = formatISTTime(item.timestamp);
      const sizeKb = item.folder_size_bytes ? `${Math.round(item.folder_size_bytes / 1024)} KB` : '';
      const details = item.details || {};
      let detailText = '';
      if (details.burst_ids) {
        detailText = `Bursts: #${details.burst_ids.join(', #')}`;
      } else if (details.moved_items) {
        detailText = `Moved: ${details.moved_items.join(', ')}`;
      }

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="trash-item-main">
          <div class="trash-item-top">
            <span class="trash-item-title">${escapeHtml(item.project_name || 'Unknown')}</span>
            <span class="trash-scope-badge">${escapeHtml(scopeLabel)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="trash-item-meta">
            <span>Deleted: ${escapeHtml(timeStr)}</span>
            ${detailText ? `<span>${escapeHtml(detailText)}</span>` : ''}
            ${sizeKb ? `<span>Size: ${sizeKb}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="trash-item-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs btn-restore-trash" data-trash-id="${escapeHtml(item.trash_id)}">
            ⟲ Restore
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger-outline btn-xs btn-purge-trash" data-trash-id="${escapeHtml(item.trash_id)}">
            ✕ Purge
          </button>
        </div>
      `;

      card.querySelector('.btn-restore-trash').addEventListener('click', (e) => handleRestoreTrash(item.trash_id, e.currentTarget));
      card.querySelector('.btn-purge-trash').addEventListener('click', (e) => handlePurgeTrashItem(item.trash_id, e.currentTarget));

      fragment.appendChild(card);
    });

    DOM.trashBinItemsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    DOM.trashBinItemsContainer.appendChild(fragment);
  } catch (err) {
    DOM.trashBinItemsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state" style="color: #ef4444;">Failed to load trash bin: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
}

export async function handleRestoreTrash(trashId, btnEl) {
  const originalText = btnEl ? btnEl.innerHTML : null;
  if (btnEl) {
    btnEl.disabled = true;
    btnEl.textContent = 'Restoring…';
  }
  try {
    showToast(`Restoring '${trashId}'…`, 'info');
    const res = await fetch(`/api/trash/restore/${encodeURIComponent(trashId)}`, { method: 'POST' });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Restore failed');
    }
    showToast(`Restored successfully!`, 'success');
    await loadTrashBinItems();
    await updateTrashCount();
    await refreshProjects();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Restore error:', err);
    showToast(`Restore failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
    if (btnEl && originalText) {
      btnEl.disabled = false;
      btnEl.innerHTML = originalText;
    }
  }
}

export async function handlePurgeTrashItem(trashId, btnEl) {
  if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY PURGE '${trashId}' from disk? This cannot be restored.`)) {
    return;
  }
  const originalText = btnEl ? btnEl.innerHTML : null;
  if (btnEl) {
    btnEl.disabled = true;
    btnEl.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-sm"></span> Purging…';
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/trash/purge/${encodeURIComponent(trashId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Purge failed');
    }
    showToast(`Permanently purged '${trashId}'.`, 'success');
    await loadTrashBinItems();
    await updateTrashCount();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Purge error:', err);
    showToast(`Purge failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
    if (btnEl && originalText) {
      btnEl.disabled = false;
      btnEl.innerHTML = originalText;
    }
  }
}

export async function handleEmptyTrashBin() {
  if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to PERMANENTLY EMPTY the entire Trash Bin? All soft-deleted items will be wiped from disk.')) {
    return;
  }
  const btn = DOM.btnEmptyTrash;
  const originalText = btn ? btn.innerHTML : null;
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-sm"></span> Purging…';
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/trash/purge-all', { method: 'DELETE' });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Empty trash failed');
    }
    showToast(`Trash Bin emptied (${data.purged_count || 0} items purged).`, 'success');
    await loadTrashBinItems();
    await updateTrashCount();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Empty trash error:', err);
    showToast(`Empty trash failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (btn && originalText) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerHTML = originalText;
    }
  }
}

export function populateDeleteProjectInfo() {
  if (DOM.delModalProjectName) {
    DOM.delModalProjectName.textContent = state.selectedProject || '—';
  }
  if (DOM.deleteProjectError) {
    DOM.deleteProjectError.classList.add('hidden');
    DOM.deleteProjectError.textContent = '';
  }
  if (DOM.chkDeleteRemoteGithub) {
    DOM.chkDeleteRemoteGithub.checked = false;
  }

  const radios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="delete-scope"]');
  radios.forEach((r) => {
    r.checked = r.value === 'local_session';
    const opt = r.closest('.scope-option');
    if (opt) opt.classList.toggle('selected', r.checked);
  });

  if (DOM.deleteBurstsContainer) DOM.deleteBurstsContainer.style.display = 'none';
  if (DOM.deleteSessionContainer) DOM.deleteSessionContainer.style.display = 'block';
  if (DOM.deleteRemoteOption) DOM.deleteRemoteOption.style.display = 'none';

  if (DOM.selDeleteSessionTarget) {
    DOM.selDeleteSessionTarget.innerHTML = '<option value="all">Entire Local Session (All Runs &amp; session.db)</option>';
    if (state.sessionsData && state.sessionsData.length > 0) {
      state.sessionsData.forEach((s) => {
        const sid = s.session_id ?? s.id;
        const bCount = s.burst_count ?? s.bursts_count ?? 0;
        const timeStr = s.start_time ? ` (${formatIST(s.start_time)})` : '';
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = String(sid);
        opt.textContent = `Session #${sid} [${bCount} burst${bCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}]${timeStr}`;
        if (state.selectedSessionId && (s.session_id ?? s.id) === state.selectedSessionId) {
          opt.selected = true;
        }
        DOM.selDeleteSessionTarget.appendChild(opt);
      });
    }
  }

  if (DOM.deleteBurstsList) {
    DOM.deleteBurstsList.innerHTML = '';
    const editEvents = (state.eventsData || []).filter((ev) => !ev.event_type || ev.event_type === 'EDIT');
    if (editEvents.length === 0) {
      DOM.deleteBurstsList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-hint">No edit bursts recorded in session.db</div>';
    } else {
      editEvents.forEach((ev) => {
        const item = document.createElement('label');
        item.className = 'burst-check-item';
        const file = ev.first_file_touched || 'edit';
        const summary = ev.summary ? ` — ${ev.summary}` : '';
        const burstLabel = ev.session_burst_label || `Burst #${ev.burst_num || ev.id}`;
        item.innerHTML = `
          <input type="checkbox" value="${ev.id}" class="burst-del-chk">
          <span><strong>${escapeHtml(burstLabel)}</strong> • <span class="mono">${escapeHtml(file)}</span>${escapeHtml(summary)}</span>
        `;
        DOM.deleteBurstsList.appendChild(item);
      });
    }
  }
}

export function openDeleteProjectModal() {
  if (!state.selectedProject) {
    showToast('Please select a project to delete.', 'error');
    return;
  }
  populateDeleteProjectInfo();
  openUnifiedSettingsModal('trash');
}

export function closeDeleteProjectModal() {
  closeUnifiedSettingsModal();
}

export function setupDeleteScopeOptions() {
  const radios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="delete-scope"]');
  radios.forEach((r) => {
    r.addEventListener('change', () => {
      radios.forEach((radio) => {
        const opt = radio.closest('.scope-option');
        if (opt) opt.classList.toggle('selected', radio.checked);
      });

      const val = r.value;
      if (DOM.deleteBurstsContainer) {
        DOM.deleteBurstsContainer.style.display = val === 'selective_bursts' ? 'block' : 'none';
      }
      if (DOM.deleteSessionContainer) {
        DOM.deleteSessionContainer.style.display = val === 'local_session' ? 'block' : 'none';
      }
      if (DOM.deleteRemoteOption) {
        DOM.deleteRemoteOption.style.display = val === 'complete_erase' ? 'block' : 'none';
      }
    });
  });

  if (DOM.btnSelectAllBursts) {
    DOM.btnSelectAllBursts.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const chks = document.querySelectorAll('.burst-del-chk');
      const allChecked = Array.from(chks).every((c) => c.checked);
      chks.forEach((c) => { c.checked = !allChecked; });
      DOM.btnSelectAllBursts.textContent = allChecked ? 'Select All' : 'Deselect All';
    });
  }
}

export async function handleConfirmDeleteProject() {
  if (!state.selectedProject) return;

  const checkedRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="delete-scope"]:checked');
  const scope = checkedRadio ? checkedRadio.value : 'local_session';
  const deleteRemote = DOM.chkDeleteRemoteGithub ? DOM.chkDeleteRemoteGithub.checked : false;

  let burstIds = [];
  let sessionId = null;
  if (scope === 'selective_bursts') {
    const chks = document.querySelectorAll('.burst-del-chk:checked');
    burstIds = Array.from(chks).map((c) => parseInt(c.value, 10));
    if (burstIds.length === 0) {
      if (DOM.deleteProjectError) {
        DOM.deleteProjectError.textContent = 'Please select at least one burst to delete.';
        DOM.deleteProjectError.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
      return;
    }
  } else if (scope === 'local_session') {
    const targetSessionVal = DOM.selDeleteSessionTarget ? DOM.selDeleteSessionTarget.value : 'all';
    if (targetSessionVal && targetSessionVal !== 'all') {
      const parsedSid = parseInt(targetSessionVal, 10);
      if (!isNaN(parsedSid)) {
        sessionId = parsedSid;
      }
    }
  }

  if (scope === 'complete_erase' && deleteRemote) {
    if (!confirm(`CAUTION: You have chosen to PERMANENTLY DELETE the remote GitHub repository for '${state.selectedProject}'. This cannot be undone from the Trash Bin. Continue?`)) {
      return;
    }
  }

  if (DOM.deleteProjectSpinner) DOM.deleteProjectSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');
  if (DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject) setButtonLoading(DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject, true, 'Deleting...');

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedProject)}/delete`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        scope: scope,
        burst_ids: burstIds,
        session_id: sessionId,
        delete_remote: deleteRemote,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Deletion failed');
    }

    const targetDesc = sessionId != null ? `Session #${sessionId}` : scope;
    showToast(`Project data moved to Trash successfully (${targetDesc}).`, 'success');
    closeDeleteProjectModal();
    await updateTrashCount();

    if (scope === 'selective_bursts' || (scope === 'local_session' && sessionId != null)) {
      await loadProjectEvents(state.selectedProject);
      await refreshProjects();
    } else {
      await refreshProjects();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Delete project error:', err);
    if (DOM.deleteProjectError) {
      DOM.deleteProjectError.textContent = `Deletion error: ${err.message}`;
      DOM.deleteProjectError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
    showToast(`Delete failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (DOM.deleteProjectSpinner) DOM.deleteProjectSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
    if (DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject) setButtonLoading(DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject, false);
  }
}

export function initModalTrashListeners() {
  if (DOM.btnHeaderTrash) DOM.btnHeaderTrash.addEventListener('click', openTrashBinModal);
  if (DOM.modalTrashBinClose) DOM.modalTrashBinClose.addEventListener('click', closeTrashBinModal);
  if (DOM.btnEmptyTrash) DOM.btnEmptyTrash.addEventListener('click', handleEmptyTrashBin);

  if (DOM.btnHeaderDeleteProj) DOM.btnHeaderDeleteProj.addEventListener('click', openDeleteProjectModal);
  if (DOM.modalDeleteProjectClose) DOM.modalDeleteProjectClose.addEventListener('click', closeDeleteProjectModal);
  if (DOM.modalDeleteProjectCancel) DOM.modalDeleteProjectCancel.addEventListener('click', closeDeleteProjectModal);
  if (DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject) DOM.btnConfirmDeleteProject.addEventListener('click', handleConfirmDeleteProject);
  setupDeleteScopeOptions();

  if (DOM.modalDeleteProject) {
    DOM.modalDeleteProject.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === DOM.modalDeleteProject) closeDeleteProjectModal();
    });
  }
  if (DOM.modalTrashBin) {
    DOM.modalTrashBin.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === DOM.modalTrashBin) closeTrashBinModal();
    });
  }
}

/**
 * SPD Analysis Engine — Modal Workspace Controller
 * Handles in-dashboard .gitignore editing, saving with silent watchdog suppression,
 * and resetting to the standard hardened template.
 */
import { DOM } from '../../dom.js';
import { state, getSelectedProjectInfo } from '../../state.js';
import { showToast } from '../../toasts.js';

export const DEFAULT_GITIGNORE_TEMPLATE = `# Environments & Secrets
.env
*.env
*.key
*.pem
*.cert

# Dependencies & Build Artifacts
node_modules/
__pycache__/
*.pyc
*.pyo
dist/
build/
.venv/
.venv*/

# Binary & Documents
*.pdf
pdf/

# SPD Analysis Engine & Runtime
.spd/
session.db*
worker.log
worker.pid*
worker.status.json
*.patch
*.tmp
`;

export async function loadWorkspaceGitignore(projectSlug) {
  const slug = projectSlug || state.selectedProject || getSelectedProjectInfo()?.name;
  if (!slug) {
    if (DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore) {
      DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore.value = '# Please select a project from the sidebar to view or edit its .gitignore';
    }
    return;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/gitignore`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok && data.success) {
      if (DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore) {
        DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore.value = data.content || DEFAULT_GITIGNORE_TEMPLATE;
      }
    } else {
      showToast(data.error || 'Failed to load .gitignore rules', 'warning');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Error loading .gitignore: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  }
}

export async function handleSaveGitignore(e) {
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  const slug = state.selectedProject || getSelectedProjectInfo()?.name;
  if (!slug) {
    showToast('Please select a project first.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const content = DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore ? DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore.value : '';
  if (DOM.btnSaveGitignore) DOM.btnSaveGitignore.disabled = true;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/gitignore`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ content }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok && data.success) {
      showToast('✔ .gitignore updated without triggering burst', 'success');
    } else {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Failed to update .gitignore');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Save failed: ${err.message}`, 'error');
  } finally {
    if (DOM.btnSaveGitignore) DOM.btnSaveGitignore.disabled = false;
  }
}

export function handleResetGitignore() {
  if (DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore) {
    DOM.txtWorkspaceGitignore.value = DEFAULT_GITIGNORE_TEMPLATE;
  }
  showToast('Reset to standard template. Click Save to apply.', 'info');
}

export function initModalWorkspaceListeners() {
  if (DOM.btnSaveGitignore) {
    DOM.btnSaveGitignore.addEventListener('click', handleSaveGitignore);
  }
  if (DOM.btnResetGitignore) {
    DOM.btnResetGitignore.addEventListener('click', handleResetGitignore);
  }
}

export function createExecAiCardHtml(ai) {
  if (!ai) return '';
  if (typeof ai === 'string') {
    try {
      ai = JSON.parse(ai);
    } catch (e) {
      return `<div class="ai-analysis-card exec-ai-card"><div class="ai-intent-text">${escapeHtml(ai)}</div></div>`;
    }
  }
  const intent = ai.intent || 'No intent description provided.';
  const techPurpose = ai.technical_purpose || 'Standard command-line execution.';
  const outcome = ai.outcome_analysis || 'Executed without errors.';
  const provider = ai.provider ? `Provider: ${ai.provider}` : 'AI Intelligence';
  const cachedBadge = ai.cached ? ' • (Cached)' : '';
  const summary = Array.isArray(ai.summary) ? ai.summary : [];

  let summaryHtml = '';
  if (summary.length > 0) {
    summaryHtml = `
      <div class="ai-section">
        <div class="ai-section-title">Key Highlights:</div>
        <ul class="ai-summary-list">
          ${summary.map((s) => `<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join('')}
        </ul>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  return `
    <div class="ai-analysis-card exec-ai-card collapsible-card">
      <div class="ai-card-header card-toggle-header" onclick="this.closest('.collapsible-card').classList.toggle('card-collapsed')">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">

      <div class="card-content-body">
        <div class="ai-section">

        <div class="ai-section">

        <div class="ai-section">
          <div class="ai-section-title">Outcome Analysis:</div>

export async function triggerExplainCommand(ev, slotEl, buttonEl) {
  state.analyzingEventIds.add(ev.id);
  if (buttonEl) {
    buttonEl.disabled = true;
    buttonEl.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Explaining…';
  }
  if (slotEl) {
    slotEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="ai-progress-track">
        <div class="ai-progress-fill"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="ai-progress-status">Explaining command intent & execution analysis…</div>
    `;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/project/${encodeURIComponent(state.selectedProject)}/analyze-exec/${ev.id}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({}),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || 'Command explanation failed');
    }

    ev.ai_summary = data.ai_summary;
    if (slotEl) {
      slotEl.innerHTML = createExecAiCardHtml(data.ai_summary);
    }
    if (buttonEl) {
      buttonEl.innerHTML = '<span class="ai-sparkle">✨</span> Re-Explain with AI';
